question.prompt: 90 kilometers are traveled in 2 hours. How many kilometers are traveled in 4 hours at the same speed? Calculate: \(90\div2\times4=?\)

solutions.explanation: At 45 kilometers per hour, the distance traveled in 4 hours is 180 kilometers.
solutions.title: Find the distance traveled per hour

solutions.explanation:
Four hours consists of two \(2\)-hour intervals. At the same speed, each interval covers \(90\) kilometers, so the total distance is
\[
90+90=180\text{ kilometers}.
\]
solutions.title: Add two equal time intervals
